note: Small rustic campground off County H north of Brule, near Bois Brule River fishing holes and canoe routes; popular with anglers in spring and fall. A canoe landing is a short walk away, and a trail across the bridge joins the Historic Bayfield Road hiking and snowshoe trail. Nearest showers and dump station are in Brule (fee). --Claude
summary: Brule River SF camping page and the DNR brochure/map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 17 units, no electric, vault toilet + hand pump, no showers/dump on site, all reservable; RVs allowed on any site. Not waterfront confirmed; pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The Bois Brule River runs about 60 m west of the campground's west edge (OSM polygon) and about 170 m from the centre; the brochure map shows sites 31-33 toward the river by a foot path beside the canoe access, and the loop sites under continuous canopy. No drive-in site is on the river; at about 20-30 m wide here it would be creek vocabulary anyway.
SITES: the old note's '14 drive-in + 3 walk-in canoe sites' is not stated on any DNR page I read (the map shows 31-33 off the road near the river, unlabelled); the count stays 17 without the split.
SEASON: no campground season published (the forest is 'Open 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. year-round', which is not a campground statement); left unset.
